standard_prerequisites: Same chapter: lemma-characterize-normal (normality via the equal-image criterion: E/F is normal iff any two F-embeddings of E into an algebraic closure have the same image)
core_obligations: For each i the roots alpha_{i,j} of the minimal polynomial P_i lie in E by hypothesis, and any F-embedding sigma of E permutes them: the sets sigma({alpha_{i,j}}) and sigma'({alpha_{i,j}}) both equal the root set of P_i in the algebraic closure
The alpha_{i,j} generate E over F, so sigma(E) = F(sigma(alpha_{i,j})) = F(sigma'(alpha_{i,j})) = sigma'(E) for all pairs sigma, sigma'; normality follows by lemma-characterize-normal
proof_roadmap: Pin the embedding images of each generator set to the common root set
Transport the equality through generation to the equal-image criterion
